chol_nb128.notes: Panel width 128 (= CONTRACT_K_LEAF_MIN, one GEMM leaf) instead of 32: guarded diagonal factor + guarded panel solve + trailing update through the identical GEMM in 512-column blocks, lower cells only, no per-panel wait, one info read. Host column (_mojolearn_gp_host) pins 128 with the same define. Bits: a cell's trailing sum bracketed per 128 columns (one 128-chain and one subtraction where v1 had four 32-chains).

eigh_tridiag_idn.notes: The Apple FAST tridiagonal eigh (Householder panels, df64 bisection, twisted vectors, compact-WY back-transform) on IDENTICAL NVIDIA/AMD: every product-meets-add / division / sqrt through checks/numerics seams, fixed 256-slot block folds, rank-2k update as ONE OP_NT identical GEMM at k = 64, back-transform as three identical GEMMs; clustered-spectrum refusal falls back to the identical Jacobi (decided by T's bits). Host column keeps the Jacobi (digest recorded, not required). Also linked by _mojolearn_linalg (its eigh_binding calls DevExec.eigh).

ols_r_trisolve.notes: lane ols-r-trisolve (ideas-dense-linalg F1): LinearRegression solves R x = c from the TSQR's R_aug in one one-block launch behind a rank gate on R's p2-equilibrated diagonal (min > eps32*d*max), computed and returned by Mojo; gate 0 keeps the Jacobi-SVD route. Bits: coefficients from the back-substitution (fixed 256-lane fold + halving tree, same on NV/AMD/host) instead of V diag(1/s) U^T c; r2 expected equal. Host column _mojolearn_x_decomp_host takes the same define.

algos:cholesky.route: fit: python/mojolearn/_cholesky_impl.py Cholesky -> bindings/_mojolearn_gp.mojo cholesky_factor_binding -> cholesky/estimator.mojo cholesky_factor_poolio -> cholesky/checks/potrf.mojo potrf_lower -> _potrf_lower_blocked (on) | _potrf_lower_strips (off)

algos:lu-factor.route: python/mojolearn/_expansion_decomp.py lu_factor -> x_decomp/api.mojo lu_py -> x_decomp/device.mojo DevExec.lu -> launch_lu (nb = 128 on, 32 off)

expanded:lu-solve.route: python/mojolearn/_expansion_decomp.py solve -> x_decomp/api.mojo lu_gesv_py -> DevExec.lu_gesv -> launch_lu + launch_lu_solve -> launch_trs_tri (GEMM feed on at nrhs >= 32)

algos:eigh.route: python/mojolearn/_expansion_decomp.py _Kit.eigh -> x_decomp/api.mojo eigh_py -> DevExec.eigh -> _eigh_on -> _eigh_td_try (on) | _eigh_par_on Jacobi (off, and the refusal fallback)

classical:ols.route: fit: LinearRegression.fit -> _ols_tsqr_centered -> x_decomp_ols_tsqr_r -> [x_decomp_ols_r_trisolve: gate 1 ends (on)] -> _tsqr_lstsq_core(Ra=...) small-R SVD (off, and gate 0)
